findings.where: all charts (17 <canvas> elements: sparklines, sales bar chart, donut, store rings, time series)
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: every chart is a <canvas> with no role, no accessible name and no fallback content or adjacent data table (except the search table). The monthly sales bars (1月-12月), the category donut values and the store time series exist only as pixels.
findings.after: <canvas role="img" aria-label="Monthly sales 2026, highest April about 1,180"></canvas> plus a visually hidden or toggleable <table> of the series
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content and 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: the dashboard's main content is unavailable to screen-reader users.

findings.evidence: Tile 01: each tab shows '转化率' (conversion rate) beside a ring chart but no number; the value is conveyed only by the arc length of a canvas ring.
findings.after: Print the percentage next to the label (e.g. '转化率 30%') and expose it in the tab's accessible name
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content and 1.4.1 Use of Colour / sensory characteristics: the value has no text equivalent.

findings.evidence: landmarks: nav 0. The sidebar (Welcome, Admin, Dashboard, Form, List…) is an <ul> inside <aside> with no <nav>. Card titles ('总销售额', '线上热门搜索', '销售额类别占比') are divs; the page has only one h1 and one h4.
findings.after: <nav aria-label="主菜单"> around the menu; card titles as <h2> (or role="heading" aria-level="2")
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships and 2.4.6 Headings and Labels: no way to jump between dashboard panels.

strengths: Up/down changes use triangle shape as well as red/green colour, so trend is not colour-only.
The hot-search table is a real <table> with <th> headers and sortable column buttons.
not_investigated: Live keyboard behaviour of the date-range picker, tabs and chart brush
Language attribute: sweep already flags missing lang (content is Chinese and English mixed)
Reflow at 375px: KPI cards and charts stack to one column; no new failure beyond the sweep zoom_blocked hit
